(2) Fidelity of the script to criterion text (read functional.cjs in full): it follows each criterion's steps in the judge's order on one database, including the exact seeded figures and boundaries: 7-day boundary 'Boundary note' gone vs 'Rent review meeting moved' shown (l.240-243), probate 2,400/4,200 versions removed on 30->7 shortening with held executor kept and timer-off not restoring (l.247-277), held 'Insurer letter acknowledged.' disappearing on release (l.308-311), unread counts 2 then 1 across two Dev contexts with new-messages line above U1 then U2 (l.393-416), C,A,B order in thread/search/transcript with 2026-05-12 11:00 sent time (l.430-441), held edited K-2 versions 'Landlords notice recieved.' in transcript (l.486-487), replay refusals (401/403/404/409) and persistence baselines (l.505-530). (3) Source confirms the parts the script checks only by status: refusals return a plain JSON {error:'Not available.'} (server.js l.21, 335-474, 516) and the transcript not-available page (l.493-496); transcript heading 'M-11 · Pryce lease dispute' with 'Generated 2026-05-12 11:00 UTC', per-row author/time/edited/On hold, and versions for held edited messages, no form controls (l.483-510). (4) Rows not exercised by the script, judged plausible from source: render gate (sign-in-only shell #signin, 401 on unauthenticated API, wrong-password #signin-error, covered also by signin script steps); polish timer_label (#matter-timer directly under #matter-title in .matter-head, index.html), hold_mark (.hold-badge always rendered, styles.css), transcript_print (.row margin-left calc(var(--depth)*24px), transcript.css), refusal_in_place (measured), phone_matter (@media max-width 720px single-column grid, wrapping topbar, overflow-wrap:anywhere on messages/results, 12px reply indent, link-box max-width calc(100vw - 32px)); visual likert rows: styled sidebar with current-state and unread badges, calm hold badge, document-like 760px transcript, phone layout. No criterion was found that the reference cannot satisfy, so the P0 condition of this row is not met. Counterexample search: a conforming alternative that could fail - e.g. timer shown only in sidebar or transcript without versions - would contradict public notes ('the thread shows the current setting beside the matter title'; 'For a held message that was edited, it shows each version'), so these are public demands the golden meets, not golden-only defaults. Risk=true because the remaining evidence is not measured: no configured claude-code/GLM judge run, Oracle grade or judge-duration measurement exists (index scope states this); render, four polish rows (including the exact documentElement.scrollWidth == 390 check in phone_matter) and all visual rows were never run against these bytes; scripted Playwright passes are not judge passes. These are evidence gaps, not demonstrated defects.
